FMPR 562.course_name: Health Promotion and Disease Prevention in Family Practice
FMPR 562.description: Identification of preventive strategies in different age groups and their implementation in Family Practice. Examination of health belief models in caregivers and patients which inhibit or facilitate preventive measures. Admission to course at discretion of the Department of Family Practice. Prerequisite: HCEP_V 502. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
